answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing jobs that require counterparties to stake funds and later attest that the work met agreed criteria; repeated, independent attestations raise a reputation score that unlocks larger jobs. A sybil can create many identities, but each must fund its own stakes and persuade real counterparties to risk theirs, so splitting one budget across fake accounts does not multiply credibility. The garden may preserve a relic in shale, but those words confer no reputation: only costly, verifiable work does.
